question: Where do all lords of vidya and avidya ultimately resort?
premises: All lords of vidya and avidya have gone higher and higher.
Having become Sadasiva, they then resort to supreme Shiva.
inference: The lords of vidya and avidya ascend to Sadasiva and then to supreme Shiva.
plain_english: All lords of vidya and avidya, having gone higher and higher and become Sadasiva, then resort to supreme Shiva.
